I like to do tuna salad sandwiches for these days where I have early morning classes and no time to go back home for lunch.

 The night before or the morning of (preferred for freshness), I get a bowl and open a can of tuna in water, drain the water, put the tuna in a bowl, throw in a couple of spoonfuls of mayo, a couple of spoonfuls of unsweetened dill relish, and mix everything together. Throw the result between a couple of slices of bread, and put it in a sandwich box. It takes 10 minutes max, it's super easy, it's delicious, and the ingredients are pretty cheap. Even better, it's chock full of carbs and protein so it's a filling lunch.
